$comment: Inventory for docs/design/CSS-NATIVE-BUILTINS.md. One row per built-in colour/math function. `class` is one of: exact | exact-if | approx | already-css | none (defined in the design doc, section 1). `css` is the CSS-native form over the parameter names; `C`, `C1`, `C2` are colours, `A` an amount on the CSS channel scale, `N`, `B` numbers. `blockedOn` names the owner question (doc section 5) that gates the row. A row is a proposal until the ledger row V38 is ruled.

functions.name: lighten
functions.css: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l + A, 100))
functions.relative: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l + l * A / 100, 100))

functions.name: darken
functions.css: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l - A, 100))
functions.relative: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l - l * A / 100, 100))

functions.name: saturate
functions.css: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s + A, 100) l)
functions.relative: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s + s * A / 100, 100) l)

functions.name: desaturate
functions.css: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s - A, 100) l)
functions.relative: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s - s * A / 100, 100) l)

functions.name: spin
functions.css: hsl(from C calc(h + A) s l)

functions.name: fade
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / A)

functions.name: fadein
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha + A))
functions.relative: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha + alpha * A))

functions.name: fadeout
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha - A))
functions.relative: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha - alpha * A))

functions.name: mix
functions.notes: ruled 2026-11-01: mix() is color-mix(in srgb), compile-time results included (no legacy weighting); weights outside 0-100% have no CSS form (Q11)

functions.name: tint
functions.notes: ruled 2026-11-01: mix() is color-mix(in srgb), compile-time results included (no legacy weighting); weights outside 0-100% have no CSS form (Q11)

functions.name: shade
functions.notes: ruled 2026-11-01: mix() is color-mix(in srgb), compile-time results included (no legacy weighting); weights outside 0-100% have no CSS form (Q11)

functions.name: average
functions.notes: ruled 2026-11-01: mix() is color-mix(in srgb), compile-time results included (no legacy weighting); weights outside 0-100% have no CSS form (Q11)

functions.name: hsv
functions.notes: exact when S and V are known, or deferred as 0-1 numbers; a deferred percentage (50%) makes (1 - S) invalid. hwb white = (1 - s)v, black = 1 - v, so white + black <= 100% always

functions.name: hsva
functions.notes: exact when S and V are known, or deferred as 0-1 numbers; a deferred percentage (50%) makes (1 - S) invalid. hwb white = (1 - s)v, black = 1 - v, so white + black <= 100% always

functions.name: rgba
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / A)
functions.notes: the 2-slot (colour, alpha) overload only, and only when C is a deferred colour that is not a substitution function: rgba(var(--rgb), .5) is the CSS channel-list idiom and stays as written. 3+ slots are CSS already

functions.name: multiply
functions.notes: per-channel product of two colours; relative colour syntax has one origin

functions.name: contrast
functions.withColors: rgb(from contrast-color(C) calc(Dr + (Lr - Dr) * r / 255) calc(Dg + (Lg - Dg) * r / 255) calc(Db + (Lb - Db) * r / 255) / calc(Da + (La - Da) * r / 255))
functions.notes: contrast-color() returns white or black by a UA-defined algorithm, no threshold; D and L must be known; a threshold argument has no CSS form. Less's 43% luma rule differs (contrast(#999) = white, contrast-color(#999) = black)

functions.name: hue
functions.notes: channel readers exist in CSS only as channel keywords inside a relative colour

functions.name: argb
functions.notes: returns #AARRGGBB text

functions.name: color
functions.notes: parses a string

functions.name: percentage
functions.notes: N a <number>

functions.name: ceil
functions.notes: N a <number>; a dimension needs B in N's unit, unknown for a deferred N

functions.name: round
functions.notes: Less P is decimal places, CSS B is a step; CSS nearest breaks ties toward +infinity, Less (V8) away from zero, hence sign/abs. Today round(var(--x), 2) prints a CSS call with the step meaning; and N is not a decimal tie: the compile rounds round(1.005, 2) in base 10 to 1.01, browser floats give 1 (V8 open sub-question)

functions.name: mod
functions.notes: Less mod is JS %, sign of the dividend = CSS rem(); CSS mod() takes the divisor's sign. Both arguments must share a type in CSS

functions.name: min
functions.notes: Less coerces a unitless argument; CSS needs consistent types

functions.name: sqrt
functions.notes: CSS sqrt takes numbers only; Less sqrt(4px) = 2px has no CSS form

functions.name: pow
functions.notes: numbers only, as sqrt

functions.name: asin
functions.notes: Less returns rad, CSS an <angle>: the same quantity

functions.name: pi
functions.notes: no input, so it always resolves

functions.name: unit
functions.notes: N a <number>; replacing or stripping a known unit is calc(N / 1<from> * 1U) by typed arithmetic

functions.name: convert
functions.notes: a converted value is the same CSS quantity; only its spelling differs

functions.name: lighten
functions.css: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l + A, 100))

functions.name: darken
functions.css: hsl(from C h s clamp(0, l - A, 100))

functions.name: saturate
functions.css: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s + A, 100) l)

functions.name: desaturate
functions.css: hsl(from C h clamp(0, s - A, 100) l)

functions.name: adjust-hue
functions.css: hsl(from C calc(h + A) s l)

functions.name: invert
functions.css: rgb(from C calc(255 - r) calc(255 - g) calc(255 - b))
functions.weighted: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(from C calc(255 - r) calc(255 - g) calc(255 - b)) W%, C)
functions.notes: the inverted colour keeps C's alpha, so the weighted mix is exact

functions.name: opacify
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha + A))

functions.name: fade-in
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha + A))

functions.name: transparentize
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha - A))

functions.name: fade-out
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / calc(alpha - A))

functions.name: mix
functions.notes: ruled 2026-11-01: mix() is color-mix(in srgb), compile-time results included (no legacy weighting); weights outside 0-100% have no CSS form (Q11)

functions.name: color.adjust
functions.css: rgb(from C calc(r + R) ...) / hsl(from C ...)
functions.notes: legacy rgb/hsl channels; one relative colour per channel family

functions.name: color.scale
functions.css: hsl(from C h s calc(l + (100 - l) * F))
functions.notes: F known: its sign picks the formula (positive: calc(l + (100 - l) * F), negative: calc(l + l * F))

functions.name: rgba
functions.css: rgb(from C r g b / A)
functions.notes: as Less rgba

functions.name: round
functions.notes: Sass B is a step, as in CSS; only the tie direction differs; and N is not a decimal tie: the compile rounds round(1.005, 2) in base 10 to 1.01, browser floats give 1 (V8 open sub-question)

functions.name: random
functions.notes: chosen at compile time; Values 5 random() is a different function

functions.name: unit
functions.notes: returns text
